biggest_catch: The 10% selling fee comes off the item price AND buyer-paid shipping combined, and it applies to the completed item price — price it in from the start.
catches: Flat 10% selling fee on the completed item price plus buyer-paid shipping (official fee structure effective Jan 6, 2025).
Buyers pay a flat 3.6% Buyer Protection fee on item price plus buyer-paid shipping — your item costs buyers more than your list price.
No additional payment processing fee for either side under the current fee structure.
ACH direct deposit withdrawals are free (one per day; $2 only for rejected withdrawals); Instant Pay costs $3 per transfer.

maximize: Price the 10% into your list price by listing ~11% above your target net (e.g., want $45 net, list at $50). Use free standard ACH direct deposit — never pay $3 Instant Pay when standard payouts are free. Remember the fee base includes buyer-paid shipping, so for heavy items the fee bites harder: use Mercari prepaid labels or offer local pickup to keep the shipping component low. Because buyers pay 3.6% on top, keep list prices competitive against other marketplaces.

s6.note: 5 steps: list, sell, ship, buyer receives, get paid.

steps: List the item (free, no listing fees) with photos and price
Wait for buyer purchase through the app
Ship the item to the buyer
Buyer receives the item (3.6% Buyer Protection fee is buyer-paid)
Receive earnings minus 10% selling fee; cash out via free standard direct deposit (or Instant Pay for $3)
timing: Payout after buyer receipt; Instant Pay within 30 min ($3); standard ACH free
who_pays: The buyer pays through Mercari, and Mercari releases the funds to you after the buyer receives the item.
who_qualifies: US sellers 18+; no special gates to start listing.
work_available: Mercari is active and open to new sellers — listing is free.
what_gets_accepted: Listings are accepted for legal, accurately described items; the sale finalizes after the buyer receives the item and the payout is released to you.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Flat 10% selling fee on the completed item price (buyer-paid shipping); no separate payment processing fee. Buyers also pay a 3.6% Buyer Protection fee, which makes your item cost them more than your list price. ACH direct deposit withdrawals are free (one per day); Instant Pay costs $3 per transfer. Unpaid time goes to photos, listing, packing, and shipping.
when_cash_arrives: After the buyer receives the item, funds release to your Mercari balance. Standard ACH direct deposit is free; Instant Pay arrives within 30 minutes for $3.
